title: Apple Podcasts
summary: Loudness and True Peak guidance for Apple Podcasts audio.
descriptionMarkdown: For podcast episodes prepared against Apple Podcasts for Creators audio guidance. The Integrated band is a warning so producers can review artistic and distribution context, while the True Peak ceiling is treated as a failure. This is specifically a podcast Profile; Apple Music uses a different workflow and is not implied by this Listing.

references.title: Apple Podcasts for Creators Audio Requirements
references.relevanceMarkdown: Defines Apple's recommended loudness range, True Peak ceiling and BS.1770 measurement basis for podcast audio.
